approval_items.wording: Formally register C, Rel_C, Dist_C, TYPE_WITNESS_C, and project_w as foundational mathematical objects.
approval_items.consequence_of_approval: Provides the formal type parameters needed for all subsequent D-semantics proofs.
approval_items.consequence_of_rejection: Blocks signature check and Lean implementation.

approval_items.wording: Classify the algebraic structure of relation witnesses as a context-indexed transport system, omitting default category or groupoid structure.
approval_items.consequence_of_approval: Prevents over-constrained algebraic assumptions (associativity, identity) that are not needed for OBL-D-001D.
approval_items.consequence_of_rejection: Forces unnecessary proof complexity for associativity.

approval_items.wording: Adopt successor witness existence without identity claim as the minimal witness identity model for OBL-D-001D.
approval_items.consequence_of_approval: Simplifies the preservation statement to requiring target witness existence rather than strict identity w' = w.
approval_items.consequence_of_rejection: Requires proof of witness equivalence classes under transport.

approval_items.wording: Adopt AX-WITNESS-REPDIST and AX-REALIZATION-WITNESS as the foundational axioms for candidate induction.
approval_items.consequence_of_approval: Establishes a sound and constructive mapping from concrete realization to representability.
approval_items.consequence_of_rejection: Blocks formability of the OBL-D-001D statement.

approval_items.wording: Defer all associativity and composition-closure commitments to future multi-step reachability theorems.
approval_items.consequence_of_approval: Allows immediate induction of the one-step preservation theory.

approval_dependencies: Human approval of all five APP items is a strict precondition for registry mutation.
canonicalization_blockers: Lack of formal signature registration in registry/math_hashes.json.
